about.text: I'm a backend-focused software engineer from Pakistan who enjoys building reliable, maintainable software and understanding how it works under the hood. I primarily work with Python and Django, building web applications and APIs with a focus on clean architecture, sensible abstractions, and well-designed data models. Alongside Python, I work with JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, and C++, continuously expanding my understanding of software beyond a single ecosystem.

projects.name: PMS
projects.description: Django REST Framework backend for project management featuring organizations, projects, tasks, RBAC, JWT authentication, Swagger documentation, and scalable REST API architecture.

projects.name: django-movie-api
projects.description: RESTful Movie Rating API built with Django REST Framework featuring JWT authentication, reviews, watchlists, filtering, nested resources, and OpenAPI documentation.

projects.name: HMS
projects.description: Hospital Management System built with Django featuring appointment scheduling, patient management, doctor dashboards, and prescription management.

projects.name: video-sharing-application-backend
projects.description: A Backend for a video sharing application. It implements authentication, media uploads, and social interactions while following a layered architecture and strict validation strategy.
